expected.charges: Attempted destruction of a police vehicle
expected.sentence: Sentenced to 18 months federal prison. On July 17, 2020 Trapp, 24, was observed by an informant and NYPD officers attempting to cut the brake line of an NYPD van, after communicating with an undercover about cutting police brake lines and conducting reconnaissance on a bridge he wanted to burn so 'white supremacists could not use it to get to Brooklyn from Staten Island.'

research_note: Original sworn October 6, 2020 complaint paragraph 6 states FBI arrested Trapp at his home August 5, 2020 and he remained in custody since. This federal admission is distinct from July 17 state arrest. Endpoint remains unknown; no sentence arithmetic, bio or case notes edits.
